This section contains the contents of the repository's files.# KIET KRA Tracker & Universal Accreditation Reporting System ## Master Architecture, Domain Model & Developer Playbook
> **Target Audience:** AI Coding Agents, Pair-Programmers, and Developers. > **Mission:** Provide an instant 360° mental model of the entire repository without consuming token budgets or requiring full-repo analysis.
---
## 1. Executive System Overview
### 1.1 Problem Statement & Solution - **Previous State:** KIET University historically tracked ~50 Key Result Areas (KRAs) across 13 engineering/management departments using a complex, error-prone manual Excel workbook. This caused data inconsistencies, dead Google Drive evidence links, unscaled target thresholds, and manual delays during NBA/NAAC accreditation audits. - **Current System:** A decoupled, role-based, intranet-hosted web application that: 1. Standardizes all ~50 KRAs into structured data schemas and archetypes. 2. Dynamically scales numeric targets based on department faculty/student strength (`target = base_target * faculty_strength`). 3. Enforces strict bi-monthly submission cycles with automated email reminders and administrative deadline exceptions. 4. Provides a split-screen live report builder for faculty/deans with pixel-perfect letterhead preview. 5. Houses a dual-engine document exporter: produces official, audit-ready **PDFs** (via `xhtml2pdf`) and editable **Word (.docx)** documents (via `python-docx`). 6. Stores raw JSON evidence and file attachments locally on the college intranet for 100% data privacy.
### 1.2 Technology Stack | Layer | Technologies | |---|---| | **Frontend** | Next.js 14+ (App Router), React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Axios, Lucide Icons | | **Backend** | Python 3.12, Django 5+, Django REST Framework (DRF), Celery 5+, Redis (Broker), SQLite (local dev) / PostgreSQL (production) | | **Document Generation** | `python-docx` (Word engine), `xhtml2pdf` + HTML templates (PDF engine) | | **Authentication** | Session & Token-based DRF Authentication with CSRF protection | | **Infrastructure** | Docker, Docker Compose, Nginx (local campus intranet deployment) |
---
## 2. Directory Layout & Key Locations
```text d:\KIET-KRA--main/ ├── core/ # Institution master definitions │ ├── models.py # Department, KRAMetric, AccreditationCriteria, ExtraTarget │ ├── views.py & urls.py # Master data REST endpoints │ └── management/commands/ # Seed scripts (e.g. init_kra_data) ├── accounts/ # Identity & Role Management │ ├── models.py # User (AbstractUser), AuditLog │ └── views.py & urls.py # Login, Logout, CSRF, Current User ('/me/') ├── tracker/ # Core KRA Tracking, Cycles & Reporting Engine │ ├── models.py # BiMonthlyCycle, CycleException, Achievement, Evidence, UploadedEvidenceFile │ ├── views.py # AchievementViewSet, stats, export views, file upload handlers │ ├── urls.py # Tracker routing endpoints │ ├── kra_reports.py # Word (.docx) styling and report builder engine for all KRAs │ └── templates/tracker/ # HTML report templates (e.g. kra_generic_report.html) ├── frontend/ # Next.js App Router Client │ ├── app/ # App router pages (page.tsx, layout.tsx, globals.css) │ ├── components/ │ │ ├── SharedHeader.tsx # Top institution header with user profile & role switcher │ │ ├── SharedSidebar.tsx # Department / Menu navigation │ │ ├── TopRoleSwitcher.tsx # Role switch dropdown (Dean ↔ Super Admin / VC) │ │ ├── dean/ # Dean dashboard, submission lists, split editor │ │ │ ├── DeanDashboard.tsx # Summary metric cards, cycle status, quick actions │ │ │ ├── DeanMyKRAs.tsx # Filterable 50-KRA grid/table with criteria tags │ │ │ ├── SplitTemplateEditor.tsx # Interactive 50/50 split: Form on left, live Preview on right │ │ │ └── DeanSubmissions.tsx # History of submitted achievements & statuses │ │ ├── vc/ # Super Admin / Vice-Chancellor / IQAC views │ │ │ ├── VCDashboard.tsx # Institution-wide performance analytics & heatmaps │ │ │ ├── VCSubmissions.tsx # Review queue to approve or reject submissions with feedback │ │ │ ├── VCKRAManagement.tsx # Route map dispatching KRA # to specialized or universal form │ │ ├── KRATemplateDataForm.tsx # Universal 10-archetype dynamic form builder │ │ ├── OfficialKRAReportPreview.tsx # Universal pixel-perfect letterhead preview │ │ ├── SmartVACReportBuilder.tsx # Master client state (user, active cycle, achievements, cache) │ ├── services/ │ │ ├── api.ts # Axios client configured with CSRF tokens and baseURL │ │ ├── kraReportService.ts # PDF & DOCX export API dispatchers │ │ └── seedData.ts # Default fallback KRAs and initial institution data │ └── types/ │ └── kra.ts # TypeScript types for KRAs, Achievements, Cycles, Submissions ```
---
## 3. Data Models & Relational Architecture
### 3.1 `core` App Models 1. **`Department`** - `name`: string (e.g. `'Computer Science & Engineering'`, `'ECE'`, `'IT'`). - `faculty_strength`: integer (used as multiplier for dynamic KRA annual targets). - `student_strength`: integer. 2. **`AccreditationCriteria`** - `nba_code`: string (e.g. `'NBA Criterion 2'`). - `naac_code`: string (e.g. `'NAAC Criterion 1.1'`). 3. **`KRAMetric`** - `serial_number`: string (e.g. `'KRA 1'`, `'KRA 7'`). - `activity_description`: text. - `target_type`: `'Numeric'` | `'Percentage'` | `'Boolean'`. - `annual_target`: string (number or descriptive threshold). - `criteria`: ForeignKey → `AccreditationCriteria`.
### 3.2 `accounts` App Models 1. **`User` (extends `AbstractUser`)** - `role`: `'SUPER_ADMIN'` (VC / Director / IQAC) or `'DEAN'` (Department Dean/HOD). - `department`: OneToOneField → `Department` (null for Super Admin). 2. **`AuditLog`** - Tracks actions, user, timestamp, IP, before_state, after_state for compliance.
### 3.3 `tracker` App Models 1. **`BiMonthlyCycle`** - `academic_year`: e.g. `'2026-2027'`. - `cycle_name`: choices = `['JUL-AUG', 'SEP-OCT', 'NOV-DEC', 'JAN-FEB', 'MAR-APR', 'MAY-JUN']`. - `deadline`: DateField (automated emails triggered 5 days prior). - `is_active`: boolean. 2. **`CycleException`** - Allows reopening a cycle for a specific department beyond standard deadline. - `cycle`, `department`, `open_until`, `reason`, `opened_by`. 3. **`Achievement` (Central Entity)** - `department`: FK → `Department`. - `kra_metric`: FK → `KRAMetric`. - `cycle`: FK → `BiMonthlyCycle`. - `status`: `'DRAFT'` | `'SUBMITTED'` | `'REJECTED'` | `'APPROVED'`. - `numeric_value`: DecimalField (for numeric metrics). - `remarks`: text. - `review_comment`: text (rejection reason or admin feedback). - `custom_data`: **JSONField** (Stores the entire structured form state for the specific KRA template, including tabular rows, coordinator names, dates, surveys, etc.). - `submitted_by`: FK → `User`. - **`dynamic_target` property**: Calculates `base_target * department.faculty_strength` dynamically. 4. **`UploadedEvidenceFile`** - Attached to `Achievement`. - `document_type`, `file`, `filename`, `file_size_kb`, `uploaded_at`, `uploaded_by`.
---
## 4. The KRA Form & Universal Reporting System
Every KRA submission requires structured evidence that can be previewed live and exported into official KIET University documents.
### 4.1 The 10 Universal KRA Archetypes To avoid writing 50 separate forms, all ~50 KRAs map onto 10 standard archetypes handled by `KRATemplateDataForm.tsx` & `SmartUniversalReportBuilder.tsx`: 1. **VAC / Certificate Course** (Course title, duration, enrolled count, syllabus, coordinator). 2. **Curriculum Feedback & Action Taken** (Stakeholder surveys, percentage satisfaction, actions). 3. **Research, Publications & Patents** (Paper title, journal/conference, Scopus/SCI, DOI, authors). 4. **Workshops, FDPs & Conferences Organized** (Event title, dates, speakers, participants, budget). 5. **Student Competitions & Hackathons** (Event name, team members, prize won, level). 6. **Industry MOUs & Supported Labs** (Company name, validity, scope, outcomes). 7. **Placements & Higher Studies** (Student list, company, CTC, university admitted). 8. **Exam Results & Remedial Actions** (Subject, pass %, fail count, corrective plan). 9. **Mentoring & Student Counseling** (Mentee batches, sessions conducted, issues resolved). 10. **Institutional Governance & Committees** (Committee name, meetings held, key minutes).
### 4.2 Split Screen Architecture - Located in `frontend/components/dean/SplitTemplateEditor.tsx`. - **Left Panel:** Interactive form (`KRATemplateDataForm`, `SmartVACReportBuilder`, or `SmartKRA7ReportBuilder`). As the user types, the state updates in real time. - **Right Panel:** Live Official Document Preview (`OfficialKRAReportPreview.tsx`). Matches the exact layout, maroon/blue KIET header, metadata tables, dynamic table rows, photo spaces, and sign-off blocks. - **Top Actions:** - `Save Draft`: Persists state to `custom_data` with status `DRAFT`. - `Submit for Approval`: Validates required fields, sets status `SUBMITTED`. - `Export PDF`: Calls `/api/tracker/export-kra-pdf/`. - `Export DOCX`: Calls `/api/tracker/export-kra-docx/`.
---
## 5. Dual-Engine Document Export Architecture
Both PDF and Word exports match official KIET University document formatting: - **Header:** KIET University Logo, Department Name, Academic Year, Cycle, Date. - **Title Block:** Official KRA Code, Formal Accreditation Title, Prepared By, Designation. - **Summary Metadata Table:** Coordinator details, venue, dates, target vs achieved. - **Data Table:** Dynamic tabular rows matching the specific KRA (with shaded header rows). - **Survey / Rating Grid (if applicable):** Questions, Likert scales, averages. - **Action Taken / Narrative:** Descriptive paragraphs and remedial plans. - **Signatures Block:** Faculty Coordinator, Head of Department, Dean of Faculty.
### 5.1 PDF Exporter (`tracker/views.py` + `xhtml2pdf`) - **Endpoint:** `POST /api/tracker/export-kra-pdf/` - **Template:** `tracker/templates/tracker/kra_generic_report.html` - **Mechanism:** Takes the submitted JSON data, renders HTML with embedded CSS, converts to PDF stream using `xhtml2pdf.pisa`.
### 5.2 Word (.docx) Exporter (`tracker/kra_reports.py` + `python-docx`) - **Endpoint:** `POST /api/tracker/export-kra-docx/` - **Mechanism:** Builds a clean, editable Word `.docx` file programmatically: - Header styling with KIET Blue (`RGBColor(0, 35, 111)`) and Maroon (`RGBColor(98, 36, 35)`). - Shaded table headers with custom borders. - Formatted paragraphs, bullets, and table widths.
---
## 6. Key REST API Endpoints
| Method | Endpoint | Description | Permissions | |---|---|---|---| | `POST` | `/api/accounts/login/` | User authentication (username & password) | Public | | `POST` | `/api/accounts/logout/` | User logout | Authenticated | | `GET` | `/api/accounts/me/` | Fetch current authenticated user & role | Authenticated | | `GET` | `/api/accounts/csrf/` | Retrieve CSRF cookie | Public | | `GET` | `/api/core/departments/` | List all departments & strengths | Authenticated | | `GET` | `/api/core/kra-metrics/` | List all 50 KRA definitions & criteria | Authenticated | | `GET` | `/api/tracker/cycles/` | List academic cycles & deadlines | Authenticated | | `GET` | `/api/tracker/achievements/` | List achievements (filtered by dept/cycle) | Authenticated | | `POST` | `/api/tracker/achievements/upsert/` | Create or update achievement with `custom_data` | Dean / Admin | | `GET` | `/api/tracker/dashboard-stats/` | Dashboard metrics, completion rates, totals | Authenticated | | `POST` | `/api/tracker/export-kra-pdf/` | Generate official PDF report for any KRA | AllowAny | | `POST` | `/api/tracker/export-kra-docx/` | Generate editable Word (.docx) for any KRA | AllowAny | | `POST` | `/api/tracker/evidence-file/upload/` | Upload supporting document/image | Dean / Admin | | `DELETE` | `/api/tracker/evidence-file/<id>/` | Delete uploaded file | Dean / Admin |
---
## 7. Developer Playbook: How to Make Changes
### 7.1 How to Add or Modify a Specialized KRA Form 1. Create or update the form component in `frontend/components/kra-forms/MyKRAForm.tsx`. 2. Register the component in `frontend/components/kra-forms/KRAFormRegistry.tsx`: ```tsx import MyKRAForm from './MyKRAForm';
// Inside getKRAFormComponent(kraNumber): if (cleanNum === 15) { return <MyKRAForm {...props} />; } ``` 3. Ensure the form saves its data into `achievement.custom_data` via `onSave(formData)`.
### 7.2 How to Adjust Report Layouts - **For PDF:** Edit `tracker/templates/tracker/kra_generic_report.html`. Note: `xhtml2pdf` supports standard CSS 2.1 (avoid flexbox/grid; use standard `<table>` layout). - **For DOCX:** Edit `tracker/kra_reports.py`. Check `generate_kra_report_docx(data)`. - **For React Live Preview:** Edit `frontend/components/kra-forms/OfficialKRAReportPreview.tsx`.
### 7.3 How to Run Backend Locally ```powershell # From root directory: python -m venv .venv .\.venv\Scripts\activate pip install -r requirements.txt python manage.py migrate python manage.py runserver ```
### 7.4 How to Run Frontend Locally ```powershell cd frontend npm install npm run dev # Accessible at http://localhost:3000 ```
### 7.5 Docker Full Stack Deployment ```powershell docker-compose up --build -d ``` Runs: - `db`: PostgreSQL container - `redis`: Redis broker container - `backend`: Django web application (Gunicorn) - `celery`: Background worker for bi-monthly deadline reminders - `frontend`: Next.js production server - `nginx`: Reverse proxy routing requests on the local intranet# REPOMIX AI CODING INSTRUCTIONS ## Project: KIET KRA Tracker & Universal Accreditation Reporting System
Welcome AI Agent. This file is an optimized Repomix bundle containing the core architecture, data schemas, backend endpoints, and frontend components for the KIET KRA Tracker.
### 1. Essential Mental Model - This is an enterprise web app replacing an Excel sheet for 13 academic departments tracking ~50 Key Result Areas (KRAs) for NBA & NAAC accreditation. - **Backend:** Django 5 + Django REST Framework + Celery/Redis. Base apps: `core`, `accounts`, `tracker`. - **Frontend:** Next.js 14+ (App Router), React 18, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript in `frontend/`. - **Key Models:** - `KRAMetric` (`serial_number`, `annual_target`, `target_type`) - `Department` (`faculty_strength`, `student_strength`) - `BiMonthlyCycle` (`JUL-AUG`, `SEP-OCT`, etc., `deadline`) - `Achievement` (links `department` + `kra_metric` + `cycle`; stores structured form data in `custom_data` JSONField) - **Target Scaling:** `dynamic_target = base_target * department.faculty_strength` (for Numeric KRAs).
### 2. KRA Form & Report Pipeline - Deans fill KRA reports using `SplitTemplateEditor.tsx` (left: form, right: live official preview `OfficialKRAReportPreview.tsx`). - Forms are routed via `frontend/components/kra-forms/KRAFormRegistry.tsx`. - Form state is stored directly in `achievement.custom_data`. - Dual Document Exporting: - **PDF:** `POST /api/tracker/export-kra-pdf/` -> `tracker/views.py` renders `tracker/templates/tracker/kra_generic_report.html` via `xhtml2pdf`. - **Word DOCX:** `POST /api/tracker/export-kra-docx/` -> `tracker/kra_reports.py` builds `.docx` via `python-docx`.
### 3. Key Conventions for Modifications - When adding/modifying forms: update `frontend/components/kra-forms/` and register in `KRAFormRegistry.tsx`. - When updating report formats: maintain consistency between `OfficialKRAReportPreview.tsx`, `kra_generic_report.html`, and `kra_reports.py`. - Preserve existing comments and docstrings. - Always check `AI_PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` at the top of this bundle ## 1. Tech Stack - **Frontend:** Next.js (App Router), React, Tailwind CSS - **Backend:** Python, Django, Django REST Framework (DRF) - **Database:** PostgreSQL - **Background Tasks:** Celery, Redis (for email reminders) - **Deployment:** Docker, Docker Compose, Nginx (Local Intranet)
## 2. Architecture Overview The application follows a decoupled client-server architecture interacting via REST APIs. - The Next.js frontend is served locally. - The Django backend exposes secured endpoints. - Celery workers continuously monitor the Postgres DB for deadlines and use Redis as a message broker to dispatch emails.
## 3. Proposed Folder Structure ```text /kiet-kra ├── /frontend │ ├── /app # Next.js App Router │ ├── /components # Reusable UI (Tailwind) │ ├── /lib # API calls (Axios) │ └── package.json ├── /backend │ ├── /core # Django base app & Auth │ ├── /tracker # KRA & Achievement logic │ ├── /reports # Template Engine & PDF generation │ ├── manage.py │ └── requirements.txt ├── /nginx # Reverse proxy config └── docker-compose.yml ```# Architecture & Tech Decisions
## 1. Why Next.js over React SPA? - **Decision:** Use Next.js App Router. - **Reason:** Provides built-in routing, better performance via server components, and is the enterprise standard for React. It handles heavy data fetching (for Admin dashboards) more efficiently than standard client-side React.
## 2. Why Django & PostgreSQL? - **Decision:** Use Django with DRF and Postgres. - **Reason:** Django offers high security out-of-the-box, a built-in admin panel for emergency database management, and a robust ORM that easily handles the complex relational mapping between Departments, dynamic KRAs, and bi-monthly achievements. Postgres enforces strict data integrity.
## 3. Why Local Intranet via Docker? - **Decision:** Host on local college servers instead of AWS/Cloud. - **Reason:** Ensures 100% data privacy. By using Docker, we avoid "it works on my machine" issues. IT staff can deploy the entire stack with a single `docker-compose up` command.
## 4. Why Celery & Redis for Emails? - **Decision:** Offload email tasks to Celery. - **Reason:** If we put a sleep timer or a synchronous loop in Django to check for deadlines 5 days prior, the server will crash. Celery runs asynchronously in the background, checking the database daily without interrupting the main web application.
## 5. Why Live Preview Templates? - **Decision:** Generate PDFs on the fly based on form data. - **Reason:** Ensures standard formatting across all 13 departments. Faculty no longer have to design their own Word documents; they just fill a form and the system generates the official compliance document.
## 6. Why Data-Driven Evidence over Manual File Uploads? - **Decision:** The Evidence model stores raw JSON data (document_data) instead of requiring an explicit file upload. - **Reason:** Faculty should be able to edit their reports later without having to re-upload PDFs. The frontend form saves the raw JSON to the database, and the backend handles generating the final PDF automatically upon export.# Design System
## 1. Color Palette - **Primary (Brand):** Deep Blue (`#1E3A8A` / Tailwind `blue-900`) - Used for headers, primary buttons. - **Secondary:** Slate (`#475569` / Tailwind `slate-600`) - Used for secondary text and borders. - **Background:** Light Gray (`#F8FAFC` / Tailwind `slate-50`) - Main application background. - **Accent/Success:** Emerald (`#10B981` / Tailwind `emerald-500`) - For "Approved" or "Target Met" badges. - **Warning:** Amber (`#F59E0B` / Tailwind `amber-500`) - For "Pending" or "In Review". - **Danger:** Rose (`#E11D48` / Tailwind `rose-600`) - For missed deadlines or errors.
## 2. Typography - **Primary Font:** Inter (or system sans-serif). - **Headings:** Bold, dark blue, tightly spaced. - **Data Tables:** Monospaced numbers for tabular data (achievements/targets) to ensure decimal alignment.
## 3. UI Components - **Forms:** Clean, bordered inputs with subtle focus rings (`ring-blue-500`). - **Cards:** Slight shadow (`shadow-sm`), rounded corners (`rounded-lg`), white background. - **Layout:** Fixed sidebar navigation for Super Admins/HODs, top app bar for user profile/logout.# Execution Flow
## 1. Deployment Entry Point 1. College IT runs `docker-compose up`. 2. **Nginx** container starts, listening on local IP port 80. 3. Nginx routes `/api/*` traffic to the **Django Gunicorn** container. 4. Nginx routes `/` traffic to the **Next.js** container. 5. **Redis** and **Celery** worker containers boot up to monitor emails.
## 2. User Authentication Flow 1. User navigates to local IP. Next.js loads the Login Page. 2. User enters credentials -> POST `/api/auth/login/`. 3. Django verifies credentials against Postgres DB and returns Session Cookies. 4. Next.js stores tokens securely. Route middleware redirects user based on Role (Admin -> Admin Dashboard, HOD -> Department Dashboard).
## 3. Data Entry & Live Preview Flow 1. Faculty selects a KRA. 2. Next.js renders the specific Template Form for that KRA. 3. As Faculty types, Next.js debounces the input and sends POST `/api/tracker/preview/`. 4. Django Template Engine processes the JSON, generates a PDF in memory, and returns the binary stream. 5. Next.js renders the PDF in the Split-Screen UI. 6. Faculty clicks "Submit" -> POST `/api/tracker/achievements/` -> Saved permanently to Postgres.
## 4. Automated Email Flow 1. Celery Beat runs a cron task every day at 00:01 AM. 2. The task queries `BiMonthlyCycle` where `deadline == today + 5 days`. 3. If true, fetches all Faculty/HOD emails associated with pending KRAs for that cycle. 4. Dispatches email jobs to Redis queue. 5. Celery Worker consumes the queue and sends SMTP emails.# Project Memory & Status

## Bugs & Fixes - *(None yet. System is in pre-development phase).*# Product Requirements Document (PRD)
## 1. Product Overview The KIET KRA Tracker is a centralized, role-based Enterprise Web Application designed to replace the existing Excel-based tracking mechanism. It tracks Key Result Areas (KRAs) across various departments for NBA and NAAC accreditation standards.
## 2. Problem Statement Currently, the institution uses a manual, error-prone Excel sheet with 13 department tabs to track ~50 KRAs. This leads to data inconsistency, broken Google Drive evidence links, lack of dynamic target scaling based on department strength, and significant delays in generating compliance reports.
## 3. Goals - Eliminate manual spreadsheet entry. - Ensure strict data typing (numbers vs text). - Securely store evidence locally without relying on external cloud links. - Automate reminders and report generation. - Dynamically scale KRA targets based on faculty/student strength.
## 4. Target Users 1. **Super Admin (IQAC/Management):** Global overview, report generation, system management. 2. **HOD (Head of Department):** Department-level dashboard to monitor faculty progress. 3. **Faculty:** Fills out standardized templates and uploads evidence.
## 5. Core Features - **Dynamic KRA Distribution:** Targets automatically multiply based on department faculty/student counts. - **Template & Live Preview:** Standardized forms for data entry that instantly generate a PDF preview before submission. - **Automated Email Reminders:** Emails sent 5 days before bi-monthly deadlines. - **Intranet Security:** Completely local deployment via Docker. - **Role-Based Access Control:** Strict data isolation between departments.# Project Rules & AI Guidelines
> **ATTENTION AI AGENTS:** If you are an AI reading this file, you must strictly adhere to all rules below. Treat this folder as your primary context.
## 1. AI Execution & Workflow Directives - **Read Before Acting:** Before writing code, always read ask.md to know what is next, and read memory.md to understand the current state. - **Always Branch:** NEVER push directly to main for new features. Always create a new Git branch for your specific task (e.g., git checkout -b feat/task-name). - **Continuous Documentation:** Update Project details (memory.md, ask.md) after every new piece of work is completed, and explicitly detail to the user what was done.
## 2. General Principles - **DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself):** Extract reusable logic in both Next.js components and Django services. - **Fail Fast:** Validate data at the frontend boundary, and strictly enforce it at the Django ORM level. - **Security First:** Never expose local file paths. Always use Django Session Authentication for API access.
## 3. Tech & Coding Standards - **Next.js / Frontend:** TypeScript strictly. Tailwind CSS for styling. Components must be functional and use Hooks. - **Django / Backend:** Follow PEP8 styling guidelines. Keep "Fat Models, Thin Views". Use Django REST Framework Serializers for validation.
## 4. Project Structure Rules - API responses must be standardized: { "data": ..., "message": "...", "status": ... } - Use environmental variables (.env) for secrets.# Full Project Task Breakdown (Phases 1-3)

font-weight: bold; font-size: 8pt;"> [Attached: {{ att.fileName }}]</span> {% endif %} {% endfor %} </li> {% endfor %} </ul> </body> </html>from django.contrib import adminfrom django.apps import AppConfig class TrackerConfig(AppConfig): name = 'tracker'import os import io from datetime import date from django.conf import settings from docx import Document from docx.shared import Pt, Cm, RGBColor from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH from docx.enum.table import WD_ALIGN_VERTICAL from docx.oxml.ns import qn from docx.oxml import OxmlElement KIET_BLUE = RGBColor(0, 35, 111) KIET_MAROON = RGBColor(98, 36, 35) KIET_LIGHT = RGBColor(232, 237, 247) def _get_logo_path() -> str: possible = [ os.path.join(settings.BASE_DIR, 'frontend', 'public', 'images', 'kiet_university_logo.png'), r"d:\KIET-KRA--main\frontend\public\images\kiet_university_logo.png", ] for p in possible: if os.path.exists(p): return p return "" def _get_logo_b64() -> str: possible = [ os.path.join(settings.BASE_DIR, 'frontend', 'public', 'images', 'kiet_logo_b64.txt'), r"d:\KIET-KRA--main\frontend\public\images\kiet_logo_b64.txt", ] for p in possible: if os.path.exists(p): try: with open(p, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return f.read().strip() except Exception: pass return "" def _normalize_rows(raw_rows, expected_keys, expected_cols_count): """ Normalizes rows into a list of lists of strings, handling both list of dicts and list of lists/tuples, ensuring S.No. is at index 0. """ rows = [] for i, item in enumerate(raw_rows): if isinstance(item, dict): row = [str(i + 1)] + [str(item.get(k, '') if item.get(k) is not None else '') for k in expected_keys] rows.append(row) elif isinstance(item, (list, tuple)): if len(item) >= expected_cols_count: rows.append([str(x) if x is not None else '' for x in item[:expected_cols_count]]) elif len(item) == expected_cols_count - 1: rows.append([str(i + 1)] + [str(x) if x is not None else '' for x in item]) else: rows.append([str(x) if x is not None else '' for x in item]) return rows def _set_cell_bg(cell, hex_color: str): """Set background color for a Word table cell.""" tc = cell._tc tcPr = tc.get_or_add_tcPr() shd = OxmlElement('w:shd') shd.set(qn('w:val'), 'clear') shd.set(qn('w:color'), 'auto') shd.set(qn('w:fill'), hex_color) tcPr.append(shd) def _make_paragraph(para, text: str, bold=False, size_pt=10, align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT, color: RGBColor = None, italic=False): para.clear() run = para.add_run(text) run.bold = bold run.italic = italic run.font.size = Pt(size_pt) if color: run.font.color.rgb = color para.alignment = align return para def _add_header(doc: Document, dept: str, kra_num: str, title: str, prepared_by: str, designation: str, cycle: str, academic_year: str, report_date: str): """Add standard KIET header and info block to a document.""" logo_path = _get_logo_path() if logo_path: logo_para = doc.add_paragraph() logo_para.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER logo_para.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0) logo_para.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2) run = logo_para.add_run() run.add_picture(logo_path, width=Cm(6.0)) # Institution heading heading = doc.add_paragraph() heading.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(2) heading.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1) _make_paragraph(heading, 'Krishna Institute of Engineering & Technology (KIET) (Deemed to be university)', bold=True, size_pt=11.5, align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER, color=RGBColor(0, 0, 0)) sub = doc.add_paragraph() sub.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(1) sub.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4) _make_paragraph(sub, 'Delhi-NCR, Ghaziabad — ISO 9001:2015 Certified', size_pt=9, align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER, color=RGBColor(80, 80, 80)) # Divider border_para = doc.add_paragraph() border_para.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4) pPr = border_para._p.get_or_add_pPr() pBdr = OxmlElement('w:pBdr') bottom = OxmlElement('w:bottom') bottom.set(qn('w:val'), 'single') bottom.set(qn('w:sz'), '16') bottom.set(qn('w:space'), '2') bottom.set(qn('w:color'), '622423') pBdr.append(bottom) pPr.append(pBdr) # Report title t_para = doc.add_paragraph() _make_paragraph(t_para, title.upper(), bold=True, size_pt=12, align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER) kn_para = doc.add_paragraph() _make_paragraph(kn_para, f'KRA {kra_num}', bold=True, size_pt=11, align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER, color=KIET_MAROON) # Info table tbl = doc.add_table(rows=3, cols=4) tbl.style = 'Table Grid' data = [ ['Name of School/Department', dept, 'Academic Session', academic_year], ['Reporting Period (Bi-Monthly Cycle)', cycle, 'Date of Report', report_date], ['Report Prepared By', prepared_by, 'Designation', designation], ] for r_idx, row_data in enumerate(data): row = tbl.rows[r_idx] for c_idx, cell_text in enumerate(row_data): cell = row.cells[c_idx] cell.text = cell_text if c_idx in (0, 2): cell.paragraphs[0].runs[0].bold = True cell.paragraphs[0].runs[0].font.size = Pt(9) _set_cell_bg(cell, 'F7F7F7') else: cell.paragraphs[0].runs[0].font.size = Pt(9) doc.add_paragraph() def _add_section_heading(doc: Document, text: str): para = doc.add_paragraph() run = para.add_run(text) run.bold = True run.font.size = Pt(10) run.font.color.rgb = KIET_MAROON shading = para._p.get_or_add_pPr() # inline highlight using character shading isn't trivial; use bold + color only def _add_table(doc: Document, columns: list, rows: list): """Generic bordered table with header row.""" if not columns: return tbl = doc.add_table(rows=1 + len(rows), cols=len(columns)) tbl.style = 'Table Grid' # Header hdr = tbl.rows[0] for c_idx, col in enumerate(columns): cell = hdr.cells[c_idx] cell.text = col cell.paragraphs[0].runs[0].bold = True cell.paragraphs[0].runs[0].font.size = Pt(9) _set_cell_bg(cell, 'E8EDF7') # Rows for r_idx, row_data in enumerate(rows): row = tbl.rows[r_idx + 1] for c_idx, val in enumerate(row_data): cell = row.cells[c_idx] cell.text = str(val) if val is not None else '' cell.paragraphs[0].runs[0].font.size = Pt(8) doc.add_paragraph() def _add_kv_table(doc: Document, items: list): """Key-value table for extra sections.""" tbl = doc.add_table(rows=len(items), cols=2) tbl.style = 'Table Grid' for r_idx, (label, value) in enumerate(items): row = tbl.rows[r_idx] row.cells[0].text = label row.cells[0].paragraphs[0].runs[0].bold = True row.cells[0].paragraphs[0].runs[0].font.size = Pt(9) _set_cell_bg(row.cells[0], 'E8EDF7') row.cells[1].text = str(value) if value is not None else '' row.cells[1].paragraphs[0].runs[0].font.size = Pt(9) # set column widths row.cells[0].width = Cm(7) doc.add_paragraph() def _add_signatures(doc: Document, prepared_by: str, designation: str, dept: str, report_date: str): """Two-column signature block.""" tbl = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2) left = tbl.rows[0].cells[0] right = tbl.rows[0].cells[1] for cell, name, role in [(left, prepared_by, designation), (right, 'HOD / Dean', dept)]: p = cell.add_paragraph() p.add_run('Signature: ' + '_' * 25 + '\n\n').font.size = Pt(9) r = p.add_run(f'Name: {name}\nDesignation: {role}\nDate: {report_date}') r.font.size = Pt(9) # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # Context builders — produce the template context for the generic HTML template # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── def _base_ctx(data: dict, kra_num: str, title: str) -> dict: today = date.today().strftime('%d/%m/%Y') return { 'kra_number': kra_num, 'report_title': title, 'department': data.get('department', ''), 'academic_year': data.get('academicYear', data.get('academic_year', '2026-2027')), 'cycle': data.get('cycle', ''), 'report_date': data.get('reportDate', today), 'prepared_by': data.get('preparedBy', data.get('facultyName', data.get('coordinatorName', ''))), 'designation': data.get('designation', 'Professor & Dean'), } def build_generic_ctx(data: dict, kra_num: str, title: str) -> dict: """ Build a template context for the generic HTML PDF template. data must contain: department, cycle, academicYear, columns, rows, and optionally: tablTitle, extraSections, narrative, surveyQuestions, overallSatisfaction, suggestions, ratingOptions. """ ctx = _base_ctx(data, kra_num, title) ctx['table_title'] = data.get('tableTitle', 'Activity Details') ctx['columns'] = data.get('columns', []) ctx['rows'] = data.get('rows', []) ctx['survey_questions'] = data.get('surveyQuestions', []) ctx['rating_options'] = data.get('ratingOptions', ['Poor(1)', 'Satisfactory(2)', 'Good(3)', 'Very Good(4)', 'Excellent(5)']) ctx['overall_satisfaction'] = data.get('overallSatisfaction', '') ctx['suggestions'] = data.get('suggestions', '') ctx['extra_sections'] = data.get('extraSections', []) ctx['narrative'] = data.get('narrative', '') ctx['logo_b64'] = _get_logo_b64() return ctx # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # DOCX generators — one per KRA family # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── KRA_TITLES = { '8': 'Curriculum Feedback – Employer and Industry', '9': 'Curriculum Feedback – Alumni', '10': 'Curriculum Feedback – Academic Expert (Outside)', '11': 'Report on Bridge Courses Conducted', '13': 'Report on Industry Advisory Board', '18': 'Activity Report – Functional MoU with Industry / Research Organization', '19': 'Industrial Visit Report', '23': 'Report on Skill Development and Employability Training', '33': 'Alumni Events Organized', '36': 'Report on Administrative Training Programs (FDP / STP)', '37': 'Report on Faculty Development Programs', '44': 'Report on BOOT Camps and Peer Learning Activities', '45': 'National and International Flagship Event Report', } def _feedback_docx(data: dict, kra_num: str, title: str, respondent_label: str) -> bytes: """ Generic DOCX for structured feedback KRAs (8, 9, 10). data keys: department, cycle, academicYear, respondentName, designation, email, mobileNumber, organization, subject, ratings (dict {q_id: rating_value}), overallSatisfaction, suggestions, surveyQuestions """ doc = Document() today = date.today().strftime('%d/%m/%Y') _add_header(doc, data.get('department', ''), kra_num, title, data.get('respondentName', ''), data.get('designation', respondent_label), data.get('cycle', ''), data.get('academicYear', '2026-2027'), data.get('reportDate', today)) _add_section_heading(doc, f'{respondent_label} Details') _add_kv_table(doc, [ ('Name', data.get('respondentName', '')), ('Designation / Role', data.get('designation', respondent_label)), ('Organization / Company', data.get('organization', '')), ('Email', data.get('email', '')), ('Mobile No.', data.get('mobileNumber', '')), ('Subject / Programme Reviewed', data.get('subject', '')), ]) questions = data.get('surveyQuestions', []) ratings = data.get('ratings', {}) rating_labels = {1: 'Poor', 2: 'Satisfactory', 3: 'Good', 4: 'Very Good', 5: 'Excellent'} if questions: _add_section_heading(doc, 'Feedback Survey Responses') cols = ['S.No.', 'Survey Statement', 'Rating (1–5)', 'Rating Label'] rows = [] for q in questions: qid = str(q.get('id', '')) rating_val = ratings.get(qid) or ratings.get(int(qid) if qid.isdigit() else qid) rows.append([ q.get('id', ''), q.get('statement', ''), str(rating_val) if rating_val is not None else '—', rating_labels.get(rating_val, '—'), ]) _add_table(doc, cols, rows) _add_kv_table(doc, [ ('Overall Satisfaction (1–10)', str(data.get('overallSatisfaction', ''))), ('Suggestions / Comments', data.get('suggestions', '')), ]) _add_signatures(doc, data.get('respondentName', ''), respondent_label, data.get('department', ''), data.get('reportDate', today)) buf = io.BytesIO() doc.save(buf) uploaded.file.url, "file_size_kb": uploaded.file_size_kb, "document_type": uploaded.document_type }, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED) def delete(self, request, pk=None): try: uploaded = Response({"error": "Permission denied."}, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN) uploaded.delete() return Response({"message": "File removed successfully."}, status=status.HTTP_200_OK) except Super Admin access required."}, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN) total_achievements = Achievement.objects.count() approved_achievements = Achievement.objects.filter(status='APPROVED').count() pending_achievements = Achievement.objects.exclude(status='APPROVED').count() dept_stats = [] departments = Department.objects.all() for dept in departments: dept_total = Achievement.objects.filter(department=dept).count() dept_approved = Achievement.objects.filter(department=dept, status='APPROVED').count() completion_rate = (dept_approved / dept_total * 100) if dept_total > 0 else 0 dept_stats.append({ "department": dept.name, "total_submissions": dept_total, "approved": dept_approved, "completion_percentage": round(completion_rate, 2) }) return Response({ "institutional_overview": { "total_kra_submissions": total_achievements, "total_approved": approved_achievements, "total_pending": pending_achievements, "overall_completion_rate": round((approved_achievements / total_achievements * 100), 2) if total_achievements > 0 else 0 }, "department_breakdown": dept_stats }, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)venv/ __pycache__/ *.pyc *.pyo *.pyd .Python db.sqlite3 .env .idea/ .vscode/

# REPOMIX AI CODING INSTRUCTIONS ## Project: KIET KRA Tracker & Universal Accreditation Reporting System
Welcome AI Agent. This file is an optimized Repomix bundle containing the core architecture, data schemas, backend endpoints, and frontend components for the KIET KRA Tracker.
### 1. Essential Mental Model - This is an enterprise web app replacing an Excel sheet for 13 academic departments tracking ~50 Key Result Areas (KRAs) for NBA & NAAC accreditation. - **Backend:** Django 5 + Django REST Framework + Celery/Redis. Base apps: `core`, `accounts`, `tracker`. - **Frontend:** Next.js 14+ (App Router), React 18, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript in `frontend/`. - **Key Models:** - `KRAMetric` (`serial_number`, `annual_target`, `target_type`) - `Department` (`faculty_strength`, `student_strength`) - `BiMonthlyCycle` (`JUL-AUG`, `SEP-OCT`, etc., `deadline`) - `Achievement` (links `department` + `kra_metric` + `cycle`; stores structured form data in `custom_data` JSONField) - **Target Scaling:** `dynamic_target = base_target * department.faculty_strength` (for Numeric KRAs).
### 2. KRA Form & Report Pipeline - Deans fill KRA reports using `SplitTemplateEditor.tsx` (left: form, right: live official preview `OfficialKRAReportPreview.tsx`). - Forms are routed via `frontend/components/kra-forms/KRAFormRegistry.tsx`. - Form state is stored directly in `achievement.custom_data`. - Dual Document Exporting: - **PDF:** `POST /api/tracker/export-kra-pdf/` -> `tracker/views.py` renders `tracker/templates/tracker/kra_generic_report.html` via `xhtml2pdf`. - **Word DOCX:** `POST /api/tracker/export-kra-docx/` -> `tracker/kra_reports.py` builds `.docx` via `python-docx`.
### 3. Key Conventions for Modifications - When adding/modifying forms: update `frontend/components/kra-forms/` and register in `KRAFormRegistry.tsx`. - When updating report formats: maintain consistency between `OfficialKRAReportPreview.tsx`, `kra_generic_report.html`, and `kra_reports.py`. - Preserve existing comments and docstrings. - Always check `AI_PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` at the top of this bundle for deep architectural references.
